scope: Read-only admitted resource source inventory; no bpy scene, image-reference traversal or Unreal.

sourceInspection.runtimeEvidence: Unmeasured; source polygons/fan estimates and raw local transforms only. No evaluated scene, imported LOD, wind or render proof.
sourceInspection.preparationBoundary: Large-tree source profile: bounded parser inspected geometry, hierarchy, transforms, material slots and raw bounds without decoding UV/normal arrays. Selected prepared geometry must pass detailed UV/normal inspection before import.

sourceInspection.note: Pillow decoded extrema may be downconverted for multichannel16-bit PNG; IHDR bit depth is authoritative. Separate alpha-map values are data, not an embedded alpha channel.
